Modify or Extend Existing RTL:
Preserve the original module/interface first, then add ECC storage as a parallel array (`ram_ecc`) and compute syndrome from stored ECC vs recomputed ECC on reads.
For Hamming(7,4), implement parity exactly as `p0=d0^d1^d3`, `p1=d0^d2^d3`, `p2=d1^d2^d3` and keep `data_out` uncorrected.
Reset should clear observable outputs only (`data_out`, `ecc_error`) and leave memory contents untouched.
When cocotb reads a 1-bit flag with `.to_unsigned()`, expose it as a packed vector signal to avoid scalar `Logic` type issues.
Use first-failure triage: fix compile blockers (port-list syntax/interface mismatch) before functional ECC debug.
Integrate multiple modules into a top mo:
Unblock integration tasks by first creating the exact expected top module/file name and required companion module files so elaboration can start.
When split-module files are required but empty, add compile-safe implementations with consistent INVALID key/pointer encodings across all outputs.
Keep external interface and latency-visible behavior aligned to the harness contract before deeper refactors.
Use staged RTL only and validate with full parameter sweep after first compile fix.
Create new RTL from spec:
Create exact expected top/module filenames first, then clear compile blockers before tuning behavior.
When staged RTL is empty, implement minimal spec-aligned modules (`dynamic_equalizer`, `error_calc`, `coeff_update`) with correct ports/params/reset semantics.
For cocotb timing checks taken before `RisingEdge`, calibrate pipeline depth to observed sampling point (effective latency may differ by one cycle).
Use first failing sim-log line to prioritize root-module/elaboration fixes before algorithm refinements.
Keep arithmetic signed and fixed-width (Q2.13-compatible) to avoid sign regressions in quadrant/identity checks.
Debug/fix buggy RTL:
Start with harness first-failure triage: if cocotb monitor/utils crash before assertions, make interface-compatible signal typing adjustments so functional checks can run.
For FIFO fetch alignment bugs, verify front-of-queue selection uses index 0 for immediate output path; off-by-one queue reads silently misalign address/data/valid.
Keep `out_err_plus2` data-driven in both aligned and unaligned paths; avoid constant forcing and validate index usage for plus2 error source.
Gate FIFO pop with handshake plus compressed/unaligned condition so entries are not popped early during split-instruction assembly.
In resettable address-update logic, ensure enabled register updates load next-state (`*_d`) rather than self-hold to prevent stuck PC progression.
